sampleSummaries.summary: Transformers is a model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models.
A platform to programmatically author, schedule, and monitor workflows.

findings: Successfully generated 15 LLM summaries from README files using llama3.2 via Ollama. All 15 repos processed without errors after fixing timeout (120s->300s), README truncation (4000->2000 chars), and adding sentence post-processing.
